provider.name: AirGradient public world API
provider.publisher: AirGradient; public contributor The Urban Unit (Pakistan)
provider.attribution: Live outdoor readings from AirGradient public locations contributed by The Urban Unit. Point measurements only — not a Karachi citywide average. Identify modifications; do not imply endorsement.
provider.license_note: Public world locations endpoint requires no API token. Attribute AirGradient and The Urban Unit. OpenAQ may mirror the same hardware under CC BY 4.0; this dashboard uses AirGradient as the primary live feed to avoid double-counting.

coverage_disclaimer: Each card is one outdoor sensor neighbourhood reading. It does not represent all of Karachi or Pakistan.

unavailable_targets.label: Orangi Pilot Project
unavailable_targets.notes: AQICN lists Orangi Pilot Project / Urban Unit id 162802, but AirGradient public world API returned HTTP 404 for that id and zero name matches for 'Orangi' at Stage A audit (2026-10-20). Do not fabricate Orangi readings.
